HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR CLEANERS IN FALKENBERG & VARBERG – JOIN OUR TEAM!
Do you want a job where you truly make a difference in people’s everyday lives?
Hemfrid is Sweden’s largest home cleaning company. We help our customers with cleaning, window cleaning, and other home services – always with quality and care.
We are now looking for you who want to work as a cleaner in Falkenberg and Varberg, and surrounding areas. With us, you will become part of an international team with colleagues from all over the world. Together, we deliver world-class service!
What do we offer?
· A 75% position
· Collective agreement and secure employment terms
· Fixed monthly salary – the same salary every month
· Mileage compensation between customers if you use your own car for work
· Paid travel time between customers
· Insurance (health, liability, and occupational pension)
· We care about your health! That’s why we offer a wellness allowance of SEK 2,400 per year
· Free mobile phone subscription
· Free training in home cleaning and further education in service and cleaning
· Field Lead/Buddy – point of contact and support for team members in the field on cleaning operations.
· Team meetings and social events
With us, you get the right conditions to succeed. If you have the motivation, we will give you the tools to excel!
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who:
· Enjoys working both independently and in a team
· Is detail-oriented, responsible, and committed
· Wants to grow and develop
· Speaks Swedish or English
· Can work flexible hours (Monday–Friday between 08:00–17:00)
· Is flexible and enjoys working with different customers
Requirements:
· B driver’s license
Meritorious:
· Access to your own car
· Experience in cleaning or service-related jobs
Apply today! Read more at www.hemfrid.se/karriar and apply  If you have questions, feel free to contact us at hr@hemfrid.se
We look forward to hearing from you! ✨

The Opportunity
Hitachi Energy Cooling Systems is currently experiencing strong growth and is looking to strengthen our Plant Design team with a Project Engineer. Our mechanical design work is divided into three areas: system design, design of units that are assembled and tested in our factory, and design of external piping systems, where pipes are welded and delivered to site for installation.
This position is part of one of our mechanical design teams, responsible for designing external piping systems in a project-based environment.
The team is based in Landskrona, Sweden. We are a strong and collaborative team with a broad range of shared expertise, where teamwork is always a top priority.
We are excited to get to know you and learn what you can bring to the team, so we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement. We value potential, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
How you’ll make an impact
Perform mechanical design work for external piping systems within project deliveries.
Create 3D models of piping systems and pipe supports based on process flow diagrams, specifications, and component lists.
Review and verify engineering drawings to ensure quality and compliance.
Manage material registration and bill of materials (BOM) creation in our ERP system.
Collaborate closely with customers, colleagues, and cross-functional teams such as Procurement and Production.
Work with engineering and business systems including Solid Edge and SAP. 

Your background
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering.
A few years of experience in piping design and mechanical design engineering or closely related engineering disciplines. Combined with a desire to continue learning and growing.
Experience working in project-based environments.
Proficiency in 3D modeling and design tools.
Experience from industries such as industrial cooling, water and wastewater treatment, biogas, marine, oil and gas, or nuclear power is an asset.
A proactive and self-driven approach, with the ability to manage priorities and meet project deadlines.
Curiosity, problem-solving skills, and a practical understanding of manufacturing and installation processes.
Fluent in both Swedish and English.

More about us 
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
Group life insurance and additional insurances.​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
Health care and wellness allowance​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
Psychological support program​​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​
Are you ready for a new and exciting opportunity? Does this role sound like a good match for your skills and ambitions? Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply today.

About Edblad
Edblad is a Swedish jewelry brand with a strong Scandinavian identity and a passion for creating accessible, contemporary jewelry designed to be worn every day. With a growing international presence, Edblad continues to develop its digital business and customer experience across multiple European markets.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence how Edblad tells its story digitally and contribute to the continued development of our e-commerce business.
About the role
As Senior e-commerce Content Creator, you will take ownership of how the Edblad story is brought to life across e-commerce, with the website as your primary channel.
This is a key role at the intersection of e-commerce and Marketing. You will take seasonal campaigns, concepts and creative direction from Marketing and Design and turn them into relevant and engaging digital content - from editorial stories and landing pages to gift guides, category content and other inspirational touchpoints.
Working across our international markets, you will consider the audience, market maturity and stage of the customer journey when shaping the message. Creativity and strong copywriting are at the heart of the role, combined with a commercial and data-driven approach to continuously improve how our content performs.
Key responsibilities:
Own the storytelling and consistency of e-commerce content, with the website as the primary channel
Translate seasonal campaigns and creative concepts into inspiring and commercially relevant digital content
Create and develop copy, editorial content, landing pages, gift guides and other inspirational content around the Edblad brand, collections and products
Adapt content and messaging to different markets, audiences, channels and stages of the customer journey
Use GA4 and content performance data to evaluate, optimize and develop content based on customer behaviour and commercial objectives
Develop content with SEO, search intent and evolving AI-driven search behaviours in mind
Collaborate closely with Marketing, Design, Performance, Social Media and E-commerce, including briefing additional content and assets when needed

Who we are looking for
We are looking for a senior content professional with excellent copywriting and storytelling skills and a strong understanding of e-commerce.
You have a strong creative instinct and know how to communicate a brand in a way that feels relevant and engaging. At the same time, you are comfortable using data to challenge assumptions, understand what resonates with customers, and make informed decisions about what to develop further.
As a person, you are proactive, curious, and eager to learn. You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating across functions and keeping up with new technologies, content trends and changing customer behaviours.
Experience & skills:
3+ years of relevant experience within e-commerce content, digital content, editorial content or a similar role
Excellent copywriting and storytelling skills, with a strong understanding of brand and tone of voice
Strong understanding of e-commerce and how content can support commercial objectives
Experience using GA4 or similar tools to evaluate content performance and inform decisions
Good understanding of SEO and search intent
Experience working with content across different markets and audiences
Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
Experience from fashion, jewelry, beauty, lifestyle, retail or D2C, as well as experience with Storyblok, Centra or international e-commerce, is considered an advantage

An interest in AI, GEO, and how new search behaviours are changing the way customers discover brands and products is a plus.
Location & start
The position is based at Edblad’s office in Stockholm. Edblad offers a hybrid working model with the possibility to work remotely.
Contact & application
If you have any questions about the position, you are warmly welcome to contact the responsible recruiter, Julia Salming, at julia@ecommercerecruit.se (jennifer@ecommercerecruit.se).
As we review applications on an ongoing basis, we recommend submitting your application as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you!

Senior Software Developer - Network Control R&D -  Job Summary
The R&D Network Control team is looking to onboard an expert Senior Software Developer at our development team located in Sweden. In this role you work in close collaboration with other developers, product owners, architects and testers. You will be developing the power grids of the future, creating software that is used in crucial infrastructure and real time. The product is designed to have a long life while also being very efficient and secure. 
How you’ll make an impact
The Senior Software Developer handles designing, developing, and maintaining mission-critical software solutions that support electric utility transmission, distribution, generation, and market operations. 
This role contributes to the development of scalable, secure, and high-performance applications within Hitachi Energy's Network Control portfolio, including SCADA, EMS, DMS, ADMS, WAMS, and related platforms. 
As a senior technical contributor, the individual drives development and maintenance activities, ensures high-quality software delivery, and collaborates closely with Product Management, System Architects, Quality Assurance, and Customer Delivery teams. The role combines strong technical ability with customer-focused mindset to deliver reliable solutions for critical infrastructure.
Your Background 
University degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
Minimum 5 years of professional software development experience in enterprise, high-performance, or mission-critical software environments.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments with cross-functional global teams.
Experience working in fast passed environment, quickly adapts to changing priorities and business needs.
Proven experience in identifying root causes of complex software issues and implementing sustainable corrective actions.
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Hands-on experience using AI-powered development tools to improve developer productivity and software quality.
Comfortable working in customer-facing environments and taking part in technical discussions with customers and stakeholders.

Technical Competencies
Expert proficiency in C# and .NET Framework/.NET platform development
Experience with C++ development is an added advantage.
Expertise in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, JavaScript
Strong hands-on experience developing Windows desktop applications using WPF, Experience building rich client applications.
Strong hands-on experience with WCF, REST APIs, Web Services, Inter-Process Communication and Message-based communication framework
Strong knowledge of Multithreading, Asynchronous Programming, Process and Thread Synchronization, Performance Tuning and Optimization
Experience working with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and architecture patterns (Microservices, SOA, Distributed System Architecture)
Experience developing Application Domains (AppDomain), Cross-process communication, Native and managed code interaction, System-level and kernel-level API interaction.
Experience with SQL/Oracle/PostgreSQL/Data Modeling/ Query Optimization / Database Performance Tunning
Experience with File Handling, Serialization / Deserialization techniques
Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
Knowledge of non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security).
Proficiency with GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, AI coding assistants, and intelligent code generation tools.
Hands on with working with static code analysis and security analysis tools, and software maintainability practices.
Effective communication and teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams.
Fluency in English, both spoken and written is needed to effectively collaborate in global environment.

What we offer
Collective agreement
Flexible working hours
Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy, both within Sweden and globally
Various training and education supporting employee development
Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

What we do at Blykalla
Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit https://www.blykalla.com.

What you’ll get to do
You will own the design of the radioactive waste management systems for SEALER, covering the liquid, gaseous, and solid waste streams generated by the reactor over its life. This includes the systems that process, characterise, condition, package, and store waste, from the cover gas cleanup that handles activation products in the primary loop, to the treatment of contaminated liquids from maintenance operations, to the interfaces with spent fuel and decommissioning.
The lead-cooled fast reactor environment presents distinct waste challenges, solutions here need to combine solid nuclear waste engineering fundamentals with a proper understanding of the lead chemistry environment.
Define the functional and design requirements for SEALER's radioactive waste management systems, covering liquid, gaseous, and solid waste streams.
Develop and maintain the design basis for cover gas cleanup, liquid radwaste treatment, and solid waste characterisation, packaging, and storage.
Lead trade-off studies on waste minimisation at source versus downstream treatment, and quantify the impact on plant footprint, cost, and dose.
Interface with the Nuclear and Safety and licensing teams on waste categorisation, disposal routes, and regulatory expectations in Europe (i.e. SSM) and in the US (NRC).
Define the scope of supplier work packages on waste system equipment, evaluate proposals, and steer their execution through qualification.
Coordinate with the Material and Lead Chemistry teams on activation products and the handling of lead-contaminated components.
Support decommissioning-oriented design choices during the concept and preliminary design phases.
Contribute to the waste-related sections of the plant safety case and licensing documentation.

Who you’ll get to work with
The Nuclear Waste System Engineer sits in the Fluid Systems Engineering Team within Blykalla, and reports to the Manager of Fluid Systems Engineering. You will collaborate closely with the Nuclear and Safety, Material, Test and Validation, and Quality teams, as well as with external suppliers, research partners, and regulators. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla.

 
Who you are
You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help for you to succeed in this role, these are:
More than 5 years of professional experience in radioactive waste management, ideally in reactor design, waste treatment facility engineering, or spent fuel handling.
Degree in nuclear, chemical, environmental, or a closely related engineering discipline.
Working knowledge of the physical and chemical processes involved in liquid radwaste treatment (evaporation, ion exchange, filtration), gaseous waste cleanup (HEPA, adsorbers, delay beds), and solid waste conditioning (cementation, drum packaging).
Familiarity with nuclear waste categorisation (LLW, ILW, HLW) and disposal routes in at least one national regulatory framework.
Comfort writing clear technical specifications, reviewing supplier deliverables critically, and managing a multi-vendor technical dialogue from concept through qualification.
Familiarity with CAD tools and engineering software.
Fluent in English, spoken and written.
Fluency in Swedish is a plus.

Meritorious skills:
Experience with waste systems in Generation IV reactor programmes (LFR, SFR, MSR) or in research reactors with unusual coolants..
Experience interfacing with SSM (Sweden) or NRC (US) on waste-related submittals.
Prior work on commissioning or decommissioning of nuclear facilities.
Familiarity with activation calculations and source term evaluation.
Experience with nuclear waste transport, interim storage, or final disposal facilities.

Location 
This position is for our office in Stockholm.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

Are you a System Developer who enjoys turning business needs into smart, reliable solutions? At FM Mattsson, you’ll work closely with teams across the organisation to develop and improve business-critical systems, with a particular focus on our ERP platform, Infor M3.
 
The role
 
Digitalisation plays an important role in how FM Mattsson continues to evolve. Our systems and digital solutions are designed to support our operations and help us work more efficiently. As a System Developer, you will join our Digitalisation team and collaborate with teams across the organisation to turn business needs and ideas into effective technical solutions. Your role will span development, integrations and problem-solving, with a particular focus on our ERP system, M3. 
In this role, you will:
Develop, customise and maintain internal applications and solutions within M3 and our wider system landscape.
Develop and maintain integrations between M3 and other systems.
Design technical solutions and help establish shared technical standards and best practices.
Develop, test and quality-assure solutions, as well as troubleshoot complex technical issues.
Contribute to and lead development and digitalisation initiatives.
Collaborate with teams across the organisation, internal specialists and external partners, and coordinate external M3 consultants when needed.
Help improve processes and ways of working across the organisation.

 
What we’re looking for
 
We’re looking for someone who enjoys using technology to solve real business challenges and is eager to understand what users and the organisation actually need. You are curious, pragmatic and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. As you’ll work with people across different parts of the organisation, strong communication and collaboration skills are important. 
We’re looking for someone with:
A university degree in software development, systems design or a related field.
Experience in software development and programming, preferably with Java, JavaScript and Angular or similar technologies.
Experience working with ERP systems or other business-critical systems.
A good understanding of databases, integrations and system architecture.
The ability to understand business needs and turn them into effective technical solutions.
Excellent written and spoken Swedish and English.

It is an advantage if you also have experience in:
Infor M3.
Integrations and automation.
The manufacturing industry.
AI-assisted software development or the use of AI tools in development.

 
Practical details
 
Start date: As soon as possible / by agreement
 
Employment type: Permanent position
 
Location: Mora, Sweden, or Odense, Denmark
 
Hiring Manager: Head of Digitalisation Benny Skoog (benny.skoog@fmmattssongroup.com)
 
Union representative (Unionen): Claes Frisk (+46 70 375 60 34)
 
Relocation support in Mora: Through Rekryteringslots Dalarna, we can offer support for accompanying partners relocating to the area. Read more at www.rekryteringslots.se
 
Application deadline: 29 November
 
About FM Mattsson Group
 
FM Mattsson Group develops, manufactures and sells taps and related products under the well-established brands FM Mattsson, Mora Armatur, Damixa, Hotbath, Aqualla and Bristan. Our vision is to be our customers’ first choice for bathrooms, kitchens and related areas. Our core values guide how we work together and how we engage with the world around us:
The customer comes first
We win together
I step forward

In 2025, FM Mattsson Group generated revenue of approximately SEK 2.0 billion and employed around 560 people across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, the Benelux region, the UK, Germany and Italy. In 2026, the Group acquired Bristan Group in the UK, which had approximately 280 employees at the time of the acquisition. FM Mattsson AB (publ) is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.
 
How to apply
 
Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? Click “Apply” to submit your application. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The application deadline is 29 November. 
We look forward to receiving your application!

Mpya Sci & Tech was created by and for people who love technology and science. We’re not here to do what everyone else is doing. We believe that real talent lies in individuals who dare to keep growing throughout their entire lives. With extensive experience and deep industry knowledge, we’ve built a forward-leaning and cutting-edge company—our way. At Mpya Sci & Tech, we believe in a sustainable working life where we build a culture together based on genuine involvement, eager curiosity, and the freedom to be yourself. Learn more at: www.mpyascitech.com .
Would you like to develop and improve purification processes for complex proteins and help develop future medicines?
At Mpya Sci & Tech, we are looking for someone with solid experience in downstream process development and protein purification. You have a strong technical background, enjoy solving complex problems and like finding new solutions when existing methods are not enough.
As a consultant at Mpya Sci & Tech, you will have the opportunity to use your expertise in development projects at pharmaceutical and biotech companies. Your assignments may range from early-stage process development to optimization and scale-up ahead of manufacturing.
About the role
You will develop, optimize and troubleshoot purification processes for recombinant proteins and other biological molecules. This may involve developing new purification strategies, improving yield and product quality, or solving challenges related to aggregation, adsorption, instability and product loss.
Your work will include:
Developing and optimizing purification processes using chromatography and filtration.
Improving protein purity, stability, activity and yield.
Planning and evaluating experiments and analyzing results.
Troubleshooting processes and making them more robust, with future scale-up and GMP manufacturing in mind.

You will work closely with other specialists and contribute your expertise to developing reliable and practical process solutions.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone with:
A relevant university degree in Life Science, preferably a PhD in biotechnology, biochemistry, chemical engineering or a related field.
Several years of experience in downstream process development and protein purification.
Hands-on experience with chromatography and filtration, such as ultrafiltration and diafiltration (UF/DF).
Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment within the development or manufacturing of biological medicines.
Experience working with CMOs/CDMOs in process development or manufacturing.
The ability to drive development work independently, analyze results and solve complex technical problems.
Excellent written and spoken in Swedish and English.

Experience in purifying challenging proteins and enzymes, scaling up processes and process validation is an advantage. Experience with regulatory documentation for biological medicines is also beneficial.
You are analytical, curious and solution-oriented. You enjoy solving technical challenges, take initiative and work well both independently and as part of a team.
How to apply
Interested in this role or curious about working as a consultant with us? Send us your application today! We interview candidates on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Application deadline: 23/11. If you have any questions, please contact Jasmin Khatibi  (jasmin.khatibi@mpyascitech.com, +46 76 163 63 00) or Johan Östman (johan.ostman@mpyascietch or +46 76 628 78 91)                                  .
Why Mpya Sci & Tech?
Mpya Sci & Tech was founded by people who love science and technology, for people who share that passion. Many of us have backgrounds in industry and consulting, so we know how important it is to find the right match, have support throughout your assignment and work for an employer who listens.
At Mpya, you can be yourself. Our office feels like a shared living room, and our culture is built on curiosity, openness and respect.
Read more at www.mpyascitech.com.
Does this sound like a role for you? We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
If you would like to become a part of a great team with highly skilled and motivated professionals, working in an innovative and developing environment, continue reading! They are a growing team and are now looking for a Product Cost Specialist.
About the role
Who is your future team?
Axis Manufacturing Capacity and Cost team is a great contributor to our company's success by developing our base of manufacturing partners and specifically secure cost competitiveness and constant improvements to our purchase costs. Your responsibility will be to ensure the right cost on Axis products through finding opportunities and driving cost reductions from our contract manufacturers, in close collaboration with your colleagues.
Who are we looking for/Who are you?
We believe you are analytical and have a great eye for details, at the same time you easily see the bigger picture from a holistic perspective. You are ambitious, self-driven and very result oriented. You thrive in collaboration with others and see the benefit of working towards common goals. You are open and your communication skills help you in reaching your goals. We see that you are curious and persistent in the work to make sure that the area of responsibility is delivered. Discussions and negotiations with internal as well as external partners are something that you enjoy, as part of your collaboration skills.
This position is very important as you will have great opportunity to affect a significant part of Axis total cost and by this, have the opportunity to affect and make a big difference to our business and continued success.
Work tasks
Be responsible for analyzing, negotiating and approving product cost quotations from Axis contract manufacturers throughout the product life-cycle.
Be responsible for identifying and driving cost reduction activities towards our contract manufacturers by analyzing quotation data and having good understanding of all relevant cost drivers.
Work in close cooperation with our contract manufacturers to achieve timely implementation of Axis negotiated component prices in product quotations.
Analyze and maintain product and component database from internal and external sources and create a benchmark to be used in price reduction activities with contract manufacturers.
Support RFQ process for new products and provide input to our product development organization regarding product cost structure and different cost drivers.
Follow-up and optimize different parameters affecting purchase cost of components at our contract manufacturers, such as order quantities, demand changes and delivery terms.
Contribute and give input to process- and IT- tools improvements within area of responsibility, independently or in collaboration with other relevant functions.

The position will mean some travels abroad.
We are looking for
A degree in Industrial Economy or Business Administration.
2-5 years of supply chain/sourcing experience, preferably from international manufacturing companies.
Experience working with RFQs, cost breakdowns, and supplier negotiations.
Experience from analyzing big amounts of data.
Advanced Excel skills and good MS Office skills.
Excellent skills in English, both orally and in writing.

It’s good if you have experience from working in ERP systems and if you have knowledge about business culture in different parts of the world, it will benefit you greatly in your future role.
Other information
Start: As soon as possible.
Scope: Full-time.
Location: Lund, and some international travel may be required.
About the assignment: You will be employed by Academic Work on a consulting assignment until the end of September 2027. If both parties are satisfied with the collaboration, there is a  possibility of being hired directly by Axis thereafter.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase.

Make It with Pride — Join Mondelēz International
At Mondelēz International, we empower people to snack right. We are one of the world's leading snack companies, home to iconic brands loved around the globe — including Milka, Oreo, Toblerone, and Marabou. Our purpose is to lead the future of snacking by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way.
For our Upplands Väsby plant, home of Marabou, Daim, Oboy and pralines we are now looking for a Maintenance Engineer to join our Asset Reliability team and play a key role in driving equipment reliability, availability, and cost-effective maintenance across our site.
About the Role
As a Maintenance Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring equipment reliability and availability through strategic preventive and predictive maintenance, aligned with our IL6S (Integrated Lean 6 Sigma) strategy. Working closely with PM Planners, Maintenance Technicians, CI Engineers, Process Engineers, and the QA department, you will develop and improve our maintenance processes — with the ultimate goal of zero breakdowns and cost-efficient maintenance.
What You'll Do
Maintenance Strategy & Planning — Develop, implement, and optimize preventive and predictive maintenance plans. Lead the IL6S PM Pillar development and ensure strategy quality and compliance.
Reliability Analysis & RCA — Lead root cause analyses (RCA) and reliability studies to identify and eliminate recurring equipment failures. Conduct Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analyses and feed insights into the CAPEX roadmap.
Competence Development — Drive training and capability building within the maintenance team and among Line Technical Leads in preventive maintenance methodology, Progressive Maintenance (PM) methods, and SAP PM usage.
Continuous Improvement & Projects — Actively lead and participate in improvement projects, systematically eliminate operational disruptions, and contribute to the continuous development of the maintenance function.
Project Management — Drive maintenance-related projects and act as requirements owner in investment projects related to maintainability and maintenance safety.
Spare Parts Management — Optimize spare parts handling, ensure inventory accuracy, and drive efficient use of resources.
KPI Tracking & Analysis — Compile, analyze, and report maintenance KPIs including MTBB (Mean Time Between Breakdowns), equipment reliability, and % TBM/CBM completion.
Calibration Ownership — Own and continuously develop the calibration program in collaboration with the Quality department.
Cost Management — Analyze and follow up on maintenance costs — including the balance between reactive and preventive maintenance — to identify improvement opportunities and ensure cost efficiency.
Quality Assurance — Ensure all maintenance work meets quality requirements per GMP standards and owns the maintenance routines that describe how work is performed.

What You'll Bring
Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent experience)
Proven experience in maintenance engineering within a manufacturing environment, preferably FMCG
Strong knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance strategies
Experience with root cause analysis (RCA) and reliability methodologies and Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analyses.
Familiarity with IL6S / TPM / World Class Manufacturing principles
Strong analytical skills and experience working with maintenance KPIs
Project management experience
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Fluent in Swedish and English

What We Offer
A key role in Asset Reliability organization at a world-class manufacturing site
The opportunity to shape and drive the maintenance strategy with real impact on operational performance
A collaborative environment where you work closely with PM Planners, CI Engineers, Process Engineers, and QA
Development opportunities within Mondelēz International's global network
Competitive compensation and benefits package

Health & Benefits
﻿Friskvårdsbidrag (wellness allowance), on-site gym.
Food & Shopping
Subsidized lunch in our canteen and favorable discounts in our staff shop.
Easy Everyday Life
Fenced parking for all on-site employees and comprehensive employee support for health, work, and private life.
Security
Collective agreement and contractual insurance.
Community
Art association and social activities.
Work schedule: 100%

jobs.occupation: Engineer Network & Cyber Security at ABB Marine & Ports
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This position reports to: Engineering Manager.
Your role and Responsibilities
ABB Marine & Ports is seeking an Engineer in Network & Cyber Security to join their Engineering & Development team. In this role, you'll drive security initiatives across the product portfolio, integrate robust security measures into products, and collaborate with R&D and Engineering teams. The ideal candidate has a degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering or Cybersecurity Engineering, experience in System Engineering and IT/OT integration, and strong communication skills.
Are you passionate about securing the future of industrial automation? Join ABB Marine & Ports as an Engineer in Network & Cyber Security and be at the forefront of innovation. In this role, you’ll work in a cutting-edge, digitalized environment, leveraging the latest tools and techniques to shape the future of our industry.
Some of your responsibilities will include:
Be a pivotal role in our Engineering & Development team, driving security initiatives across our product portfolio.
Support development teams by integrating robust security measures into our products, ensuring they meet the highest standards.
Act as a crucial link between our R&D and Engineering teams, ensuring seamless collaboration and innovation.

jobs.occupation: Global PV Risk Minimization Physician  Injectable Aesthetics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Global PV Risk Minimization Physician to join our Global Pharmacovigilance organisation within Injectable Aesthetics.
This is an influential global role for a physician with deep expertise in medical device vigilance, risk management, and post-marketing safety. You will provide medical and scientific leadership across Galderma's portfolio of injectable aesthetic medical devices, helping ensure that patient safety and benefit-risk considerations remain at the centre of product lifecycle management and strategic decision-making.
Working in a highly collaborative international environment, you will partner with colleagues across Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Commercial teams. Together, you will shape safety strategies, guide regulatory interactions, and contribute to decisions that impact healthcare professionals and patients worldwide.
This is a unique opportunity to combine scientific expertise, strategic thinking, and cross-functional leadership in one of the most innovative and rapidly evolving areas of dermatology.
 
Your mission
As Global PV Risk Minimization Physician, you will provide medical leadership for post-marketing safety and risk management activities across Galderma's Injectable Aesthetics medical device portfolio.
You will play a key role in shaping global safety strategies, leading benefit-risk evaluations, and driving initiatives that support the safe use of our products throughout their lifecycle. Working in close partnership with colleagues across Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Commercial teams, you will contribute scientific expertise that informs critical business and regulatory decisions.

In this role, you will:
·      Lead medical assessments of safety data, emerging signals, and benefit-risk profiles.
·      Drive risk minimisation strategies and support their implementation globally.
·      Provide expert input into regulatory submissions, safety reports, and product labelling.
·      Support interactions with Health Authorities, Competent Authorities, and Notified Bodies.
·      Contribute to safety governance and cross-functional decision-making.
·      Strengthen inspection readiness and support a culture of compliance, patient safety, and continuous improvement.
·      Act as a trusted scientific partner across the organisation and help shape the future of Injectable Aesthetics at Galderma.
 
Your profile 
You are a physician with a passion for patient safety and a strong scientific mindset. Drawing on extensive experience in medical device safety, vigilance, risk management, or related post-marketing activities, you combine deep medical expertise with the ability to navigate complex global environments and build strong partnerships across functions, cultures, and geographies.
You are comfortable translating complex scientific data into clear recommendations and practical actions, influencing stakeholders at different levels, and balancing strategic thinking with operational execution. With strong scientific judgement, a collaborative approach, and high ethical standards, you thrive in a dynamic international environment where patient safety, quality, and compliance are at the centre of decision-making.
 
What you'll bring:
Medical Doctor (MD) qualification.
10-15 years of relevant experience within global medical device safety, vigilance, risk management, or related post-marketing activities.
Strong knowledge of benefit-risk assessment, signal detection, safety surveillance, and risk minimization.
Solid understanding of global medical device regulations and vigilance requirements.
Experience interacting with Health Authorities, Competent Authorities, and/or Notified Bodies.
Knowledge of epidemiology, statistics, and safety data evaluation.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex safety data and translate insights into action.
Proven ability to lead initiatives and influence stakeholders within a global matrix organization.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively across functions and cultures.
A proactive, adaptable, and solutions-oriented mindset.
Fluency in written and spoken English.

 
Additional qualifications in Clinical Pharmacology, Drug Safety, Public Health, Epidemiology, Biomedical Engineering, or related disciplines are considered an advantage.
 
Location and information 
This position is based on-site in Uppsala, Sweden. 
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

jobs.occupation: Looking for travelling Service Technician - Stockholm Region
jobs.description:
We are currently seeking a traveling Service Technician who would like to become part of our Nordic service team! 
In this role, you will be based from your home and travel daily to customer sites using a company service vehicle. Your assignments will be centrally planned by service coordinators at the headquarters in Stockholm. Your primary work area will be the Stockholm Region, although assignments in other parts of the Nordic region can occur as well. 
You will be part of a team and report to the Team Leader within Mettler Toledo's Product Inspection and Transport & Logistics segments. 
This means that your customers will primarily be found within the food industry, pharma, manufacturing sector, and transportation and logistics industry. The products you will work with are related to inspection, measurement, and weighing processes. The overall purpose of your role is to ensure that our products are installed, calibrated, and maintained correctly. 
Customer communication and documentation of completed work are important parts of the role. Onboarding and continuous training are also included. 
Key Responsibilities:
Installation, troubleshooting, repairs, calibration, and preventive maintenance of Mettler Toledo products and instruments 
Administration within the CRM system 
Ensuring a high level of customer service 
Active collaboration with colleagues such as service technicians, planners, and sales representatives 
Participation in training sessions and meetings organized by Mettler Toledo 
Contributing to and upholding Mettler Toledo's corporate values and code of conduct

What You Need to Succeed
To succeed in this role, you are curious, service-minded, and technically inclined. 
You are solution-oriented, flexible, and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction and quality, you consistently deliver effective solutions and excellent service. 
Qualifications: 
Technical background in electrical engineering, automation, or mechanics 
Experience troubleshooting technical equipment and strong knowledge of electronics 
General IT proficiency, including experience working with PCs and Microsoft Office 
Well-organized, service-oriented, positive, and flexible regarding working hours and travel 
Valid Category B driver's license and enjoys being on the road 
Strong administrative skills 
Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken

Our Offer to You
In addition to great colleagues and a varied, meaningful job, we offer excellent development opportunities and regular training courses. Service training is typically conducted in Switzerland and Germany, and on-the-job training alongside experienced colleagues is also provided regularly.   
Benefits at Mettler Toledo Sweden: 
Company car  
Wellness allowance (fitness benefit)  
Edenred lunch benefit  
Monthly reimbursement for home office expenses  
Access to the Benifex benefits portal (including exclusive company discounts for personal use)  
Opportunity to apply for a First Card corporate credit card  
Occupational pension plan (ITP1/ITP2)  
Collective bargaining agreement (Technology Industries Agreement)  
Computer glasses/protective eyewear when needed, as well as a free eye examination (for permanent employees)  

For traveling service technicians, specific compensation rules apply for travel time and overtime. Further details will be provided during the recruitment process. 
Additional Information: 
﻿The recruitment process includes occupational psychology assessments through Alva Labs as well as a background check. 
About Mettler Toledo
METTLER TOLEDO is a global leader in precision instruments and services. We are renowned for innovation and quality across laboratory, process analytics, industrial, product inspection, and retailing applications. Our sales and service network is one of the most extensive in the industry. Our products are sold in more than 140 countries, and we have a direct presence in approximately 40 countries. For more information, please visit www.mt.com.

jobs.occupation: Snickare till längre uppdrag i norra Finland
jobs.description:

LETA Consulting AB söker erfarna och utbildade snickare för längre uppdrag hos våra kunder i norra Finland. Har du yrkesstolthet, flera års erfarenhet och letar efter nästa steg i din karriär? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig!
Vi samarbetar med etablerade aktörer inom byggbranschen och söker nu duktiga snickare till projekt inom nyproduktion, renovering och industriella byggnationer. Uppdragen är långsiktiga och för rätt person finns goda möjligheter till fast anställning direkt hos kund.
LETA Consulting AB is looking for experienced and trained carpenters for longer assignments with our clients in northern Finland. Do you have professional pride, several years of experience, and are looking for the next step in your career? Then we would love to hear from you!
We work with established players in the construction industry and are now looking for skilled carpenters for projects in new construction, renovation, and industrial building. The assignments are long-term, and for the right person, there are good opportunities for permanent employment directly with the client.
Om tjänsten / About the job
Som snickare via LETA Consulting blir du en del av vårt kompetenta team på plats ute hos kund. Du arbetar heltid enligt finska kollektivavtal och placeras i projekt i norra Finland. Vi hjälper till med praktiska frågor såsom boende och resor, så att du kan fokusera på det du är bäst på – ditt hantverk.
As a carpenter through LETA Consulting, you become part of our skilled team on-site with the client. You work full-time according to the Finnish collective agreement and are placed in projects in northern Finland. We help with practical matters like housing and travel so you can focus on what you do best – your craft.
Vi erbjuder dig / We offer you
- Anställning enligt finska arbetsvillkor och kollektivavtal - Lön enligt avtal - Långsiktiga uppdrag hos etablerade kunder - Hjälp med boende och praktiska arrangemang - Möjlighet till övergång till kund för rätt person - Trygghet och stöd från en erfaren arbetsgivare - Start omgående och löpande
- Employment according to Finnish working conditions and collective agreements - Salary according to the agreement - Long-term assignments with established clients - Help with accommodation and practical arrangements - Opportunity to transition to the client for the right person - Security and support from an experienced employer - Immediate start and ongoing opportunities
Vi söker dig som har / We are looking for someone who has
- Yrkesbevis eller motsvarande utbildning som snickare - Gedigen erfarenhet inom byggbranschen - Självständig arbetsstil och god samarbetsförmåga - B-körkort är meriterande - Talar svenska, finska eller engelska (koncernspråket är engelska)
- A professional certificate or equivalent education as a carpenter - Solid experience in the construction industry - An independent working style and good teamwork skills - A driver's license (B) is a plus - Speaks Swedish, Finnish, or English (the company language is English)
📩 Ansökan / Application
Skicka in ditt CV via länken i annonsen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post på grund av GDPR. Sista ansökningsdag är den 30 november men vi rekryterar löpande, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt!
Submit your CV via the link in the ad. We do not accept applications by email due to GDPR. The last application date is November 30, but we are recruiting continuously, so send in your application as soon as possible!
Frågor? / Questions?
Kontakta gärna / Feel free to contact Johan Larsson 📧 johan.larsson@letaconsulting.se  +46 76-800 23 43
Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att matcha dig med ditt nästa bygguppdrag!
We look forward to receiving your application – we’re excited to match you with your next construction assignment!

The opportunity 
At Hitachi Energy our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact on our communities and society.
We are in a steep expansion, and you will be part of Hitachi Energy Cooling Systems business unit in Landskrona. We have a global responsibility for the development and manufacture of cooling systems for Power Electronic applications and other applications that require water cooling systems with high reliability and availability.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the green transition and create a more sustainable energy future for all. So, if you want to take the next step in your career, and contribute to develop a stronger, smarter, and greener energy system – Join us now, we are ready for you!

Plan, schedule, and perform regular inspections and maintenance activities to help prevent equipment fail-ures and minimize production downtime.

Support and promote operator maintenance activities and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and 5S practices from a maintenance perspective.
Perform and coordinate calibration of instruments and equipment.
Identify and initiate equipment upgrades to improve reliability, efficiency, and performance.
Manage the procurement of maintenance-related equipment, tools, and spare parts.
Work closely with Production and Production Engineering teams to improve machine performance, extend equipment lifespan, and support energy-efficiency initiatives.
Ensure machinery, equipment, and maintenance activities comply with relevant safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.

You have a technical background and solid experience working with structured maintenance in a production or manufacturing environment.
Experience with Lean principles and 5S methodologies is considered an advantage.
You are proactive, collaborative, and solution-focused, with a strong drive to achieve results.
You build positive relationships and communicate respectfully and effectively with colleagues, customers, and external partners.
You can identify opportunities for improvement and help implement practical solutions related to equipment reliability and performance.
You are organized and able to manage priorities effectively, meet deadlines, and maintain a calm, problem-solving approach in a fast-paced environment.
You have strong communication skills and are comfortable expressing yourself clearly in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.

More about us 
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
Group life insurance and additional insurances. 
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank 
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) 
Health care and wellness allowance 
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)
Psychological support program 
Supplementary compensation for parental leave 
Various trainings and education supporting employee development 
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally 
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks
